name: Hunahpu
role: One of the Hero Twins of the Popol Vuh, a hunter and ballplayer who helps defeat Seven Macaw and the lords of Xibalba.
fun_fact: Hunahpu loses an arm to Seven Macaw in the Popol Vuh, and the twins win it back through cleverness rather than force.

name: Xbalanque
role: The second Hero Twin, Hunahpu's brother, known for trickery and skill at the ball game.
fun_fact: His name is usually explained with reference to the jaguar (balan), and he is often portrayed as the more cunning of the twins.

name: Hun Hunahpu
role: Father of the Hero Twins and one of the first ballplayers, whose journey to Xibalba sets the whole story in motion.
fun_fact: After his death his head is placed in a calabash tree, and it is from that tree that his sons are conceived.

name: Vucub Hunahpu
role: Hun Hunahpu's brother, who plays ball with him and travels with him to the underworld.
fun_fact: He shares his brother's fate in Xibalba, and the two are remembered together as the first ballplayers.

name: Xquic
role: A daughter of a Xibalba lord who becomes the mother of the Hero Twins.
fun_fact: Her name is often translated as 'Blood Moon' or 'Blood Woman', and some communities associate her with the moon.

name: Vucub Caquix
role: A boastful bird-being who claims to be the sun and the moon and is defeated by the Hero Twins.
fun_fact: His name means 'Seven Macaw', and his sons Zipacna and Cabracan are also overcome by the twins.

name: Tepeu
role: One of the creator pair in the Popol Vuh, who plans the making of human beings together with Gucumatz.
fun_fact: His name is usually translated as 'Sovereign' or 'Ruler', and he is paired with Gucumatz in the creation dialogues.

name: Gucumatz
role: The Feathered Serpent, a creator being who helps shape the world and the first people.
fun_fact: His name means 'Feathered Serpent' in K'iche', and he is often compared with Quetzalcoatl of central Mexico.

name: Huracan
role: Heart of Sky, a storm-like creator whose word brings the world into being.
fun_fact: Popular writers connect his name with the word 'hurricane', though that word reached English through Spanish from the Taíno language of the Caribbean.

name: Hun Came
role: One Death, a chief lord of Xibalba who summons the ballplayers and rules the underworld with Vucub Came.
fun_fact: His name pairs with Vucub Came, 'Seven Death', and together they lead the council of Xibalba.
